correctness.rationale: Exact torus elimination of all gradient equations gives the coordinate ring k[t]/(t^N-1); F=m times an invertible monomial on that scheme, hence empty or unchanged according to p∤m versus p∣m. The cyclic recurrence and both closure relations are explicitly verified, with no set-theoretic shortcut. Factorization in characteristic p proves every Artin local length and the Frobenius formula. LTE yields the separate dyadic case; direct small-case Gröbner computations and standalone arithmetic checks independently stress-tested it. No computation is substituted for the infinite proof.

Exact published-record and own-claim comparisons found prior isolated characteristic-three cubic fourfold and general plane-curve singularities: those are special slices and do not imply the all-(d,m) scheme formula or 2-adic enhancement. Stronger historical coverage remains a risk.

value.rationale: The natural coefficientwise Klein hypersurface family has arithmetic bad reductions. The theorem provides a complete, intrinsic projective singular subscheme for an infinite two-parameter family, including multiplicities and residue-field point statistics rather than only a smoothness criterion. Crucially, characteristic two contains a genuine extra p-adic thickness depending on d−2, unbounded as d varies. This is a motivated structural description of previously unclassified degenerations, not a single routine numerical instance.
